name: arm-reach-lite

jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: build-arm-lite
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite; nvcc -std=c++17 -O3 --fmad=false -gencode arch=compute_89,code=sm_89 -gencode arch=compute_120,code=sm_120 -Iarm/include/lite -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -Xcompiler -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda.cu -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite/libarm_lite_cuda.so 2>&1 | tee build-arm-lite.log; g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -ffp-contract=off -Iarm/include/lite -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda_serial.cpp -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite/libarm_lite_cuda_serial.so 2>&1 | tee -a build-arm-lite.log; ls -la experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite | tee -a build-arm-lite.log

jobs.name: preflight-abi
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B arm/preflight_abi.py lite experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite/libarm_lite_cuda.so 2>&1 | tee preflight-abi.log

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -m walk.train.gpu_train --robot arm --variant lite --envs 4096 --horizon 64 --updates 99999 --seed 917 --device cuda --library experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite/libarm_lite_cuda.so --lane-env --curriculum arm-reach --policy ff --accept-every 16 --out gpu-train-out --lr 3e-4 --max-wall-s 900 2>&1 | tee gpu-train.log

jobs.name: acceptance
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -B -m walk.eval.arm_acceptance --variant lite --actor gpu-train-out/actor_final.pt --lane serial --library experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-lite/libarm_lite_cuda_serial.so --out acceptance-out 2>&1 | tee acceptance.log

notes: DELTA action contract (arm/include/<variant>/duck_model.h: DW_ENV_ACTION_MODE 1 -- target += a * MAX_INC clamped to limits, a = 0 holds; the v1-v5 ABS lineage lives in arm/include/<variant>-abs for evaluating those actors). Arm on the kernel's DEVICE POLICY PATH (--lane-env; kernel ABI v8, DW_ENV_KIND_REACH selected by arm/include/<variant>/duck_model.h): obs 27 / arm_reward v1 / acquisition / termination in-kernel, one dwc1_step_policy launch + obs/reward/done readback per policy step plus a dwc1_reach_get readback and a masked dwc1_reach_set_targets push for envs that acquired (host-drawn targets, arm_reach.py's exact stream). preflight-abi exercises dwc1 on the arm CUDA build before training, as the humanoid specs do. Parity/judge cross-check: arm/tests/test_arm_device_policy.py. Acceptance stays on the serial build via ArmReachEnv (the frozen judge consumes per-tick traces). Half-scale 1/8-mass 'lite' variant header (arm/include/lite). Reward v5 (arm_reward.py: alive + gaussian ladder at rho/2rho/4rho/8rho + hold bonus + commanded-speed and boundary speed-excess penalties) and the arm-reach tech-tree ladder (--curriculum arm-reach: acquisitions appear -> violating-tick caps 2000/800/200/40 -> 3 s first-acquisition deadline -> judge-tight). CPU validation before GPU spend: runs/arm-local-v5-long (128 envs x 1200 s, 25.8M steps) acquires under the frozen judge in 12/12 episodes (1-5 targets each, one episode all 5 in order), failing only the speed clause; the 64-env x 420 s command (7M steps) does not reach the first acquisition.
accept_probe_note: --accept-every 16: every 16 updates (~90 s at the measured ~5.75 s/update for 4096 envs x 64) the in-run probe judges the current policy on the FROZEN arm judge over the CPU harness's exact 12 cells (seeds 4242/7/1913/90210 x tiers 0/1/2, 8 s) as one E=12 batch on a fresh CUDA-lane instance (gate terminations off); 12/12 -> writes gpu-train-out/accepted/ (listed as artifacts) and stops the leg. Cost: measured 1.9 s per probe on the local serial lane (IK baseline, full 8 s episodes), estimated <= 5 s on the CUDA lane; ~10 probes x <= 5 s <= 50 s of a 900 s leg (< 5.6 %).
